beats.say: Limit one. Your stop. The price where your idea is simply wrong.
beats.cap: Limit #1: your stop. The price where your idea is simply wrong.

beats.say: Limit two. Your size. Pick it so hitting the stop costs only what you planned to lose.
beats.cap: Limit #2: your size. Pick it so hitting the stop costs only what you planned to lose.

beats.say: Limit three. A leverage cap you never go above. For example, three x.
beats.cap: Limit #3: a leverage cap you never go above. Example: 3×.

beats.say: Set all three while you're calm. Not in the middle of a red candle.
